product_one_liner.value: Forwood Safety provides critical-risk management and safety software that helps organizations in high-risk industries monitor critical controls and prevent fatalities and serious injuries.
product_one_liner.notes: The source describes Forwood CRM as SaaS fatality-prevention software and identifies its intended users as companies in high-risk industries, including mining, construction and utilities.

pricing_page.notes: The live first-party homepage navigation and footer list their links and include no pricing link, so there is no public company pricing page evidenced.

named_customers.notes: named_customers: Forwood’s announcement says Peabody Australia joined its CRM community; its PT Merdeka Copper Gold case study describes deployment of the Forwood CRM platform. Both are named customers. | named_customers.0: Forwood’s announcement states that Peabody Australia joined its CRM community and describes deployment of the solution. | named_customers.1: The Forwood case study identifies PT Merdeka Copper Gold Tbk in its title and describes the platform provided to that customer.

employee_band.notes: PitchBook lists 94 employees, which falls in the 51–100 band.

hq_location.notes: hq_city: The company profile names Brisbane as Forwood Safety’s headquarters city. | hq_country: The company profile explicitly places Forwood Safety headquarters in Brisbane, Australia.

founded_year.notes: The Forwood Safety company profile states its founding year as 1995.

eng_blog.notes: The company’s index is a general “News and Articles” stream credited to marketing and dominated by safety education, product and event content. Its isolated AWS/QuickSight-related stories do not establish at least two engineering-authored posts about how the product is built.

public_docs.notes: The first-party help center includes article links and collections with several articles, including four Forwood Users articles and one Team Management article.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The live official careers board lists four current openings, all sales or partner-success roles; none has an AI, ML or data-science role title.

model_provider.notes: Forwood’s technical article says it uses AWS QuickSight for CRM and FAST reporting and identifies QuickSight Q as its machine-learning capability; this supports AWS QuickSight Q as the publicly named provider/service.

compliance_certs.notes: compliance_certs: The Forwood trust-center page names ISO 27001:2022 and SOC 2 in its compliance section. The trust-center page could not be freshly opened during this run, so I rely on the recently verified prior capture. | compliance_certs.0: The trust-center compliance listing explicitly names ISO 27001:2022. | compliance_certs.1: The same trust-center compliance listing explicitly names SOC 2.

last_funding.notes: funding_stage: PitchBook labels the latest completed funding deal “Later Stage VC.” | funding_date: PitchBook’s latest listed deal row dates the Later Stage VC round to 31 October 2023, which converts to 2023-10.

raised_18mo.notes: PitchBook identifies the latest round as dated October 2023, more than 18 months before 2026-11-09, so no round is evidenced in the requested window.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The official current openings page lists an Account Executive – Enterprise SaaS Sales role, meeting the requested AE hiring criterion.

launched_6mo.notes: The current news index shows newer informational safety articles, not product launches. Its most recent identified launch-type item is the Safety+ 2.0/mobile-app announcement, dated 2025-01-21 in the page record—before the 2026-05-09 to 2026-11-09 window. Routine app updates are not launches of a product or major feature.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: A profile records the person’s Forwood Safety role as Head of Innovation & CTO ending in December 2025, within the 12 months before 2026-11-09; that is a C-level departure in the window.

crm_stack_signal.notes: crm_stack_signal: The case study identifies Forwood’s Zoho CRM and the use of LinkedIn lead forms routed through LeadsBridge. | crm_stack_signal.0: The case study names Forwood’s CRM as Zoho CRM. | crm_stack_signal.1: The case study names LinkedIn lead-generation forms as an integrated lead source. | crm_stack_signal.2: The case study names LeadsBridge as the integration platform connecting website and LinkedIn leads to Zoho CRM.
